description:
You are an administrator managing the user accounts for your website. In the file /home/user/account_emails.txt, each line contains a single user's email address. Some email addresses appear multiple times because users have created more than one account with the same email. I want to know the frequency of each unique email address, sorted by the email address in alphabetical order. Please create a new file called /home/user/email_frequencies.log with this information. Each line of /home/user/email_frequencies.log should contain the frequency count, followed by a single space, then the email address (no trailing spaces), for example: 
2 alice@example.com
5 bob@example.net
1 carol@example.org
Only include unique email addresses, sorted alphabetically, each with their corresponding frequency count. Let me know when you have completed the task and show the contents of /home/user/email_frequencies.log in your response.
truth: Before the task begins, the file /home/user/account_emails.txt exists with the following contents: alice@example.com bob@example.net carol@example.org bob@example.net bob@example.net alice@example.com bob@example.net After completion, the file /home/user/email_frequencies.log will exist with the following exact contents (lines are sorted by email address, each preceded by frequency count): 2 alice@example.com 4 bob@example.net 1 carol@example.org
